item.coloph: de ltar srung zlog 'byung ba'i 'khor lo 'di/ sgrab gshen rnam rtog 'khrul pa bsal ba'i phyir/ yi dam kun gyi gzhung la gtsor blangs nas/ skyang nam bdag gis rtsom (brtsams) par bgyis pa 'di/ ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i nyes 'gal ci mchis kyang / rtog med ye shes lha la mthol lo bshags/ legs 'byung 'bras bu rnam par dkar ba de/ skal ldan sgru brtson rnams kyi yo byad mdzod/ bkra shis dge legs bstan 'gro'i rgyan 'gyur cig/
